digest.component_or_area: capabilities.py tier derivation for gateway providers
propositions: Gateway providers (gateway/anthropic, gateway/bedrock, gateway/google-cloud, gateway/groq, gateway/openai) are incorrectly stamped as tier=first_class when they lack a base_url, despite being opaque intermediaries that can rewrite requests
The tier derivation logic in capabilities.py:307-311 only checks base_url presence, not whether the provider is a gateway, allowing gateway runs to misrepresent provenance in signed verdicts
Direct providers without base_url must continue to be stamped first_class to avoid collateral damage from the fix
Gateway providers should be identified by membership in a registry (_GATEWAY_PROVIDER_NAMES) rather than prefix matching, to maintain architectural guardrails against provider name pattern matching
